The main bottleneck was iterator overhead in `ufunc_at`: even for simple cases, the implementation built a buffered `NpyIter` and, for each indexed element, reset pointers, invoked the loop on a single count, and copied back through iterator advancement [T0B11:<RANGE>Create NpyIter object to "iterate" over single element of each input

         * Call to iternext triggers copy from buffer back to output array
         * after innerloop puts result in buffer.

        iternext(iter_buffer);</RANGE>].
